detail.longDescription:
PHP, TLS, etc… We appear to be facing a tsunami of vulnerabilities being
discovered in record time. Further, the window to act on these vulnerabilities
has basically closed to zero; hackers’ tools now automatically fold the very
latest vulnerabilities into their botnets within minutes/hours of discovery. I
have always been extremely reluctant to expose any of my services - even with
the latest and greatest security tools. My choice to stay totally within the
confines of tailscale seems vindicated given this week’s news. How are you all
taking this? https://pwn.watch/ [https://pwn.watch/]
